oneSentenceConcept: A cool, high-contrast hero becomes a living index where type, project fragments, and provenance shift through one coordinated focus-and-depth system.
heroConcept: Oversized anchor type holds the left edge while a narrow sequence of indexed planes occupies the right, moving as one spatial field rather than separate cards. Scroll changes the active plane; pointer focus exposes a crisp cobalt trace without hiding ordinary links.
emergingSignals: Subject matter becoming the navigation and chapter grammar
Motion, WebGL, and transitions consolidating into one coordinated runtime
Minimal two-color frames carrying one bounded dimensional focus
Creative portfolios behaving like tactile digital products
AI-native workspaces making context persistent and traceable
visualLanguage: Cool chalk and near-black establish a flat, legible field; oversized grotesk type provides the anchor while thin cobalt index lines, cropped project planes, and exact borders create spatial tension.
interactionLanguage: One active hero plane responds to scroll and pointer focus while the remaining planes recede in a predictable sequence. Links, navigation, and supporting sections retain conventional behavior and visible focus states.
motionLanguage: A single coordinated thread shifts plane position, depth, and index emphasis with short deceleration and no looping ambience. Supporting content uses restrained opacity and border-state changes only.
storytellingApproach: The hero acts as a spatial prologue and visible index; supporting sections resolve into a calm linear record so exploration never competes with comprehension.
creativeTechnologyIdeas: CSS transforms and scroll progress for the indexed hero planes
Optional lightweight canvas depth layer that never carries text or navigation
IntersectionObserver-managed active states with a static reduced-motion composition
View Transitions API crossfade for continuity without directional page theatrics
typographyDirection: Overscaled bold grotesk for the hero anchor, compact uppercase index labels, and a stable sans body with generous line height; avoid serif-editorial signaling.
compositionDirection: Asymmetric split field with a fixed typographic anchor and a compressed sequence of overlapping context planes; supporting sections return to an airy grid rhythm.
colorDirection: Cool chalk background, near-black text, and one deep cobalt focus cue with AA contrast; muted blue-gray surfaces separate context without atmospheric gradients.
textureDirection: Flat mineral surfaces, exact one-pixel rules, and subtle planar shadow only; depth comes from overlap and motion rather than glass, grain, or glow.
supportingPageTreatment: Flat cards align to visible index rules, sections keep generous space and a stable reading order, and cobalt appears only on focus, provenance, and active-state cues.
avoid: All-canvas interfaces that hide readable text or standard links
Horizontal or infinite scroll without a content-specific reason
Simultaneous cursor, shader, audio, and transition spectacles
Generic agent-dashboard chrome or chat-interface mimicry
Warm cream editorial styling and serif magazine hierarchy
Motion without an equivalent static hierarchy under reduced motion
